data.name: Bilaloon
data.gender_notes: Bilaloon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bilaloon is a beautiful and powerful name of Arabic and Urdu origin that means 'Full Moon'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'bulanah' which means 'moon' and is used to describe the night sky when it is fully illuminated by the moon. Bilaloon is a name that is full of strength and beauty, and is a perfect choice for parents who want to give their child a name that is both unique and meaningful.

In Islamic tradition, the moon is seen as a symbol of God's guidance and protection, and those who are named after the moon are believed to be blessed with wisdom, knowledge, and a strong connection to the divine. Bilaloon is a name that is rich in symbolism and meaning, and is a powerful reminder of the beauty and wonder of the natural world.

in_hindi.name: बिलालून
in_hindi.meaning: बिलालून का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक पानी या वर्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: बिलालून नाम अरबी मूल 'बिलल' से निकला है और इसका अर्थ है बहुत अधिक पानी या वर्षा। हिंदी में, यह नाम उर्वरता और विकास से जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसके अर्थ समृद्धि और आशीर्वाद से जुड़े हुए हैं।

historical_references.reference: Bilal was a young Ethiopian slave who became the first muezzin (caller to prayer) in Medina. He was a close companion of Prophet Muhammad and is highly respected in Islamic tradition.

The name 'Bilal' is believed to have been derived from the Arabic word 'bilalah', meaning 'night traveller'. This could have been due to his role as a guide for caravans during his years as a free man before his enslavement, or as a reference to his nocturnal prayers during his time as a slave.
